lines: I've been thinking about what happened with that fish.
I know you wanted me to help, but... it was already hurt. I couldn't keep hitting it.

choices.text: You're right. I shouldn't have pushed you.
We were just trying to catch it.
Can we talk about this another time?

lines: I still want to help you out there.
I just need you to trust me when I say I can't do something.
I know. But I don't want to hurt it more just because it's taking a while.
I can help you catch fish without doing that.
Okay. I just... wanted you to know why I stopped.
